about: Baselines for gate.mjs. Rules are quoted from Ryan's SKILL.md and references (upstream wheresryan22/anatomy dbf697a). Measured values come from `node scripts/gate.mjs --examples` on the light pages, 1440x1300 viewport, device scale 1, after load (2026-10-11; span, minor, subject, accent, local added 2026-10-12). test-rig and spot-plate are React/Next sources; they were measured from a static react-dom/server render of figure.tsx with the kit CSS, so their live layers are absent.

thresholds.partsMinSource: SKILL.md workflow step 1 (Figure 40-80 parts, Hero 80-150) and step 4 ('Write at least 40 parts (40-80 for a Figure, 80-150 for a Hero, more for an Epic)'). Epic: 'more' than a Hero's top, so 151.
thresholds.solidsFloorSource: Drawn solids (path.iso-fill, one per kit solid) are the measurable part of the parts list; screws, ticks and grooves are parts but not solids. Floor = min(tier part minimum, the smallest bundled example of that tier): Figure min(40, dial-indicator 38) = 38; Hero min(80, turning-dial 87) = 80; Epic has no example, 151. verify.md's checklist says '30-60 solids for an inline figure'; 38 is stricter because every bundled Figure reaches it.
thresholds.inkMinSource: Share of non-paper pixels inside that box. Examples 0.23-0.50; floor = lowest example minus 0.03. Catches a drawing whose box is mostly air.
thresholds.cellMinSource: The drawing's box split 4x4; for each cell at least 30% covered, edge-pixel density relative to the median cell. Examples' lowest cell 0.22-0.59; floor = lowest example minus 0.02. Catches a bare region: a big face or plate with nothing on it ('a bare face or an empty corner is unfinished work', SKILL.md).
thresholds.spanSource: Replaces the area fill as the FAIL (area fill could be moved by padding the card's height). Drawing box over the card on its longer axis. Examples 0.73-0.96; threshold widened 0.03 each side.
thresholds.minorMinSource: Drawing box over the card on its shorter axis: an empty band means the card is padded. Examples 0.64-0.82; floor = lowest minus 0.03.
thresholds.subjectMinSource: Box of the declared subject over the card area. Examples (subject = every solid except those whose box exceeds 1/4 of the drawing's box, i.e. the base) 0.24-0.61; floor = lowest minus 0.03.
thresholds.accentSource: Accent pixels found by painting the accent selector magenta in a second shot; share of them whose luminance is >= accentStep from the median of the drawn pixels in an accentRing-px ring around them. Examples' lit parts (.iso-solid[data-lit], lit lines) 0.29-0.86 (none in desk-computer, test-rig, raptor-engine); floor = lowest minus 0.05. A kit lit style on light-toned pins measures 0.13 (v2 lock with its ink marker removed).
thresholds.localSource: Pixels that differ between a state and the rest pose (minus pixels that change between two rest stills: idle animation), share inside the box of the state's declared changes padded localPad px. Examples with declared states (arcade-cabinet stick, ripple-tank frequency, turning-dial turn) 1.00; floor 0.8 leaves room for shadows and halos past a part's box. localMaxArea stops a figure declaring the whole card.

measured.statedCounts: SKILL.md example list: desk-computer 'about 85 solids' (measured 82), arcade-cabinet 'a Hero of about 240 solids' (251), test-rig '53 solids' (53), turning-dial 'about 90 live parts' (87). verify.md: 'the Raptor has about 270' (298 drawn).
